other_conditions: Applicant must be a legal heir (spouse, dependent, or children) of a deceased accredited journalist
If the deceased journalist was unmarried or single, assistance is released to the dependent father or mother
Financial assistance is available to serving and retired accredited journalists in cases of medical emergencies, accidents, or other adverse situations
Family annual income of the serving/retired accredited journalist must be less than ₹1,80,000
Retired journalists must have served at least twenty years as accredited journalists with the Government of Himachal Pradesh
Retired journalists must not have taken any other gainful employment besides journalism
Retired accredited journalist must be 58 years old
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹3,00,000 for serving journalists and up to ₹50,000 for retired journalists in cases of death, medical emergencies, or other adverse situations.
documents_required: medical certificate or proof of illness/accident
